text:
Gamma Deploy Bot: deploy started -> rollout v2026.3.4 to eu-prod (canary on node-pool-a). Health checks failing on canary, auto-rollback disabled for this job.
SRE Pager: P1 page triggered: 5xx spike from inference-eu canary. Auto-escalation to on-call.
oncall-bot: paging Amy C (oncall) -> please acknowledge.
Amy C: ack, I'm on it. pulling graphs now. anyone see customer impact?
Raj P: we're seeing 5xx rate ~18% over baseline on /v1/generate-eu for the last 3m, latency p95 up from 120ms -> 900ms. region EU only.
Luis M: grabbing logs from canary pod (inference-encoder-abcde):
```
kubectl -n prod logs inference-encoder-abcde -c encoder
2026-03-15T15:04:01Z ERROR healthcheck failed: GET /ready returned 500
2026-03-15T15:04:02Z INFO terminating: readiness probe failed repeatedly
```
kubectl -n prod get pods -o wide | grep inference-encoder
inference-encoder-abcde   1/2  CrashLoopBackOff   4 (2m ago)  200s  node-eu-3
inference-encoder-fghij   2/2  Running            0           5m   node-eu-4
```
Amy C: pause the rollout and stop canary from receiving traffic. I want to prevent propagation.
Raj P: run: `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/inference` and flip kill-switch for the feature flag if necessary.
Amy C: ran: `kubectl -n prod rollout pause deployment/inference` -> Gamma Deploy Bot: rollout paused (v2026.3.4).
Gamma Deploy Bot: traffic re-routing to baseline complete (canary removed from LB).
Luis M: looking at the manifest diffs: new container image changed readiness endpoint env var from `/ready` -> `/healthz` but the code still serves `/ready`. liveness/readiness mismatch. Also HPA scaled up to 0->10 because metric config uses wrong target (avgCPU vs custom request-rate).
Raj P: that'll explain crashloops + HPA churn. Patch plan: 1) toggle feature flag `inference-new-encoder` -> off, 2) patch deployment to correct readinessProbe path, 3) set HPA minReplicas=2 and stabilize.
Amy C: toggle flag now? who can do the toggle?
Luis M: I can. toggling flag via internal flags-api: `POST https://flags.internal/api/toggle` body `{ "flag": "inference-new-encoder", "value": false }` -> response 200.
Luis M: flag toggled -> immediate drop in 5xx to ~2% within 30s. graphs: https://grafana/redwood/graph?panel=generate-eu
Raj P: good mitigation. next: patch readiness probe. applying quick patch:
```
kubectl -n prod patch deployment inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/readinessProbe/httpGet/path","value":"/ready"}]'
```
Amy C: applied. rolling restart of affected pods: `kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference`
oncall-bot: restart requested by Amy C.
Luis M: after restart, canary pods stabilized, no crashloops, readiness ok. HPA stabilized after minReplicas=2 set.
Raj P: long-term fix: revert the manifest change in the repo (PR opened), add unit tests for readiness env var, and update HPA metric to request-rate with proper targets.
Amy C: created short incident summary and assigned follow-ups: PR #3421 to revert, #3422 to fix HPA config, postmortem assigned to Raj.
SRE Pager: incident ticket INC-2026-041 created, severity P1 -> reduced to P2 after mitigation.
Amy C: customer impact: approx 12 minutes of elevated errors for EU tenants, some requests retried by clients. No data loss. Notifying account teams (cc: @sales, @cs).
Raj P: handing off to me for postmortem. Amy, thanks for the quick pause and routing. I will collect timelines and RCA.
Amy C: handing to Raj P as incident lead — summary: root cause = manifest change with readiness path mismatch + incorrect HPA metric causing scaling instability during drain. Mitigation: pause rollout, toggle feature flag, patch readiness, restart, set HPA minReplicas.
oncall-bot: oncall handoff complete -> new owner: Raj P.
Gamma Deploy Bot: rollback option still available; we kept v2026.3.3 stable as baseline.
Raj P: closing note: will run a targeted canary tomorrow with a smaller pod churn window and add a pre-deploy probe test to CI.
Amy C: thanks all. I bookmarked logs and saved `kubectl describe` output in incident gist. :thumbsup:
SRE Pager: resolved alert after stabilization.
Gamma Deploy Bot: incident thread closed (auto-archive in 7d).
